record.paper: Blow-ups and extensions of trees in tournaments

dossier_meta.paper: Blow-ups and extensions of trees in tournaments
dossier_meta.statement_text: There exists a constant $C$ such that $\operatorname{unvd}(D)\leqslant C\cdot\operatorname{unvd}(D-v)$ for every acyclic digraph $D$ and for every vertex $v$ of $D$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture generalizes Proposition 1, which gives $\operatorname{unvd}(D)\leqslant 2\operatorname{unvd}(D-x)$ only when $x$ is a source or sink of $D$, to arbitrary vertices. Together with Sumner's Conjecture 4, it implies Conjecture 10 about $k$-extensions of oriented trees.
